reviews.text: My dog ​​has been going there for years, it's an excellent place.

I recommend them without hesitation! Denise, Danilo, and the team of monitors have always been very attentive and helpful. Even when we left him for a weekend stay and he couldn't stay there, they found another daycare for him, took him for exams, for adaptation, and everything... they were very helpful and concerned about Shelby's well-being. They always keep us informed about Shelby's behavior, if anything is different, in other words, the care and support is very personalized. I think what best defines the quality of Hause's service is Shelby's enthusiasm for going and how much he loves being there! Haha
They require vaccines without proven scientific efficacy, make life difficult for the client, and do not maintain adequate records of the animals.

Hause is an amazing place. I've been a client for 2 years and I trust them completely. They are extremely attentive, responsible, and careful with the pets, and they are always innovating in terms of space and activities for the animals. They are super quick to respond and keep you updated on your pet at all times. I highly recommend them, without a doubt!
Great place, I would definitely trust my children there 🩷 …
Incredible service, careful with the pets, the interaction and care are very well attended to and monitored.
There is no veterinarian, and the daycare performs examinations on the animals in an unknown location without the owners' authorization.
My dog ​​loves the place! They are very attentive. The Hause offers different activities throughout the day and he comes back very happy!

For the first time, we needed to leave our boys, Tom and Simba, at a pet hotel for a few days.

We looked at several places, but when we found Hause's profile, we felt confident in Denise and Danilo, who presented Hause, its entire structure, and their concern for the dogs' well-being.

It was the best choice we made!

Besides their concern for the environment and creating new activities every day, they showed great affection and provided all the necessary assistance to them throughout their stay. Simba and Tom were treated like family.

They were always very organized, sending us videos and photos of how they were doing, which made us feel more secure during the day.

So, if you are looking for a hotel or daycare for your pet, we wholeheartedly recommend Hause.

We hope that Uncle Danilo and Aunt Denise will want to welcome us again in the future, haha.

Despite being right next to my house, I discovered Hause through an internet search during a difficult time, after trying to adapt to another place. From the beginning, my dog ​​and I received excellent care, and it's been almost two years of one of the best partnerships I've ever had (no exaggeration, haha). Hause is the best place to leave your dog, with the certainty that they will be safe, happy, expending energy, and very well looked after. Gilberto, my dog, LOVES it, and so do I! :)
I'm very biased when it comes to Hause! My greyhounds, Mila and Miguilim, have become much more sociable since they started going there. All the staff are caring, attentive, and trustworthy!

All the professionals are wonderful, they took care of Katia as if she were their own. We left her with them for a month, they always sent us photos and videos of her, and they were super attentive in noticing that, due to the activities …
